title: South and Central Vietnam
alt: Reunification Palace gates in Ho Chi Minh City
transport: A domestic flight, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Saigon, Cu Chi and the Mekong
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, walking distance from the market

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels half day tour
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnel Half Day Tour
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through a widened section of the original shafts.

activities.name: Saigon city tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum and the Ben Thanh market.

activities.name: Mekong Delta day tour
activities.description: South to My Tho for a boat into the coconut creeks, a sampan through the palms, and the workshops where they make coconut candy.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Three nights in District 1 with the Cu Chi tunnels, a city tour and a full day in the Mekong Delta.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Hoi An and Ba Na Hills
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few streets back from My Khe beach

activities.name: Hoi An with a Thu Bon river boat ride
activities.match: Hoi An Day Tour from Da Nang with Thu Bon River
activities.description: A day in the old trading town with the Japanese bridge and the merchant houses, and a boat out onto the Thu Bon river as the lanterns come on.

activities.name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: The flight to the central coast for two nights, with Hoi An by lantern light and a full day up at Ba Na.

day_titles.2: Saigon and the Cu Chi tunnels
day_titles.4: North to Da Nang and Hoi An

1: Arrival at Tan Son Nhat and transfer to your hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the rooftop bars on Nguyen Hue
2: Breakfast, then north west to Cu Chi
The tunnels, the trapdoors and the kitchens
Back in the city for the palace and the cathedral
The war remnants museum and Ben Thanh market
3: Breakfast, then south into the delta
A boat through the coconut creeks at My Tho
A sampan ride under the palms
The coconut candy workshops, then back to the city
4: Breakfast and check out, then the flight north
Check in near My Khe beach in Da Nang
South to Hoi An for the afternoon
A boat on the Thu Bon as the lanterns come on
5: Breakfast, then the cable car up to Ba Na
The Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands
The French village and the gardens at the top
Back down to Da Nang in the evening
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Da Nang airport for your flight home

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Six days without the long run north. The south and the centre are enough for a first visit if your leave is short.
expert.tip: Fly out of Da Nang rather than doubling back to Saigon. It saves you most of a day.

summary: Six days across the south and centre: three nights in Saigon with the Cu Chi tunnels, a city tour and a full day in the Mekong Delta, then two in Da Nang with Hoi An by lantern light and a day up at Ba Na Hills.
included: Included: 5 nights with breakfast and dinner daily; the domestic flight north; private transfers throughout; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour; a Saigon city tour; a Mekong Delta day tour; a Hoi An day tour with a Thu Bon river boat ride; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
